description: Resolves a postal code in one country (ISO 2-letter code, e.g. US, DE, TR, GB) to its place names, state or province, and latitude and longitude, from Zippopotam.us. Covers only the countries that service publishes. No time zone or administrative municipality is returned, since no free source for them was used. Choose this tool for: Resolves a postal code in one country to its place names. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_highres_qr_code_generator (Makes a QR code as scalable SVG for up to 17 bytes at level); agent_intel_iban_routing_swift_resolver (Validates an IBAN and, if it passes, looks up the bank). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, TR, GB

postalCode.description: Postal code as written for that country, 2 to 12 characters
